about_the_game:
SnakeVib: A Modern Twist on the Classic Snake Game

Dive into the ultimate snake game experience with SnakeVib, where classic gameplay meets exciting new challenges. Navigate through dynamic levels featuring regenerating food, rotten food to avoid, and a competitive computer snake. With unique mechanics like "Tug of War" mode, arrow shooting, and increasing speed, every level offers a fresh challenge. Customize your experience with vibrant backgrounds, videos, and music. Whether you're racing against time or battling the computer, SnakeVib is a thrilling adventure for players of all skill levels. Can you conquer all 10 levels and become the ultimate snake master?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4th Gen / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 600 Series / AMD Radeon R7 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A keyboard and mouse are required. Integrated graphics should suffice for basic gameplay, but a discrete GPU is recommended for smoother performance with video backgrounds.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: For the best experience, use a system with a dedicated GPU and a higher refresh rate monitor.
